cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Say the Scary Part
cards.instruction: Get someone else to name the frightening possibility or vulnerable feeling before you do.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Before our skating qualifier, can you say the possibility we keep avoiding?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I don't want you carrying that onto the ice.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. I'm carrying it already. I just need you to say it first.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We might not qualify. I'd still want to skate with you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Why did I need that second sentence so much? Could you name that fear too?

mechanism: A directs the naming of risk like a competent assessment while requiring B to say the frightening words first.
confusable: Simple information gathering differs from forcing the other person to voice a possibility A already fears.
comparison: A shop letter threatens inherited responsibility; a skating qualifier threatens the partnership as well as selection.
seedUse: Keep the actual unspoken fears and let B's named possibility uncover the next vulnerable layer.
